`r action$description`

### Inputs available

```{r}
#| echo: false
lines <- map_chr(names(action$inputs), function(name) {
  input <- action$inputs[[name]]
  required <- ifelse(input$required %||% FALSE, "", "_(Optional)_ ")
  description <- gsub(".[ \n\r]*$", ".", input$description)
  default <- ifelse(!is.null(input$default), paste0(" Default: `", input$default, "`."), "")
  glue::glue("* `{name}`: {required}{description}{default}")
})
knitr::asis_output(paste0(lines, collapse = "\n"))
```

## Usage

The data-intuitive/viash-lint repository is private, so a secret token is required for access (here `VLINT_TOKEN`).
Use [`pro/setup-vlint`](../setup-vlint) to install vlint before you run `pro/vlint`.

### Token required

By default (`on_missing_token: error`), the job fails when the `VLINT_TOKEN` secret is not set.
The `Setup vlint` step gives the error "No token given" and the `vlint` step does not run.
Use this when every run must check the Viash configs and you expect the token to be set.
**NOTE:** Secrets are not available in pull request workflows from forks, so this will fail for those workflows.

```yaml
name: vlint

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  vlint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Check out repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v6

    - name: Setup vlint
      uses: viash-io/viash-actions/pro/setup-vlint@v6
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.VLINT_TOKEN }}

    - name: `r action$name`
      uses: viash-io/viash-actions/pro/vlint@v6
```

### Optional token

With `on_missing_token: skip`, the job does not fail when the `VLINT_TOKEN` secret is not set.
Use this for situations where the token may not be available but you don't want to see a failed job.
The two examples below show different ways to implement this which show different output in GitHub.

#### One job


The simplest way to skip the `vlint` step is to check for the token in the `Setup vlint` step and skip the `vlint` step when it is not set.
With this approach, a notice and a line in the job summary say that the configs were not checked but the job still shows as successful in the pull request checks.
Use the two-job approach below if you want the `vlint` job to show as skipped in the pull request checks.

```yaml
name: vlint

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  vlint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Check out repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v6

    - name: Setup vlint
      id: setup-vlint
      uses: viash-io/viash-actions/pro/setup-vlint@v6
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.VLINT_TOKEN }}
        on_missing_token: skip

    - name: `r action$name`
      if: steps.setup-vlint.outputs.installed == 'true'
      uses: viash-io/viash-actions/pro/vlint@v6
```

#### Two jobs

This approach uses a separate job to check that the token is available and skip the `vlint` job when it is not set.
Because the whole `vlint` job is skipped, a skipped check is visible in the pull request checks summary.

```yaml
name: vlint

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-token:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      available: ${{ steps.check.outputs.available }}

    steps:
    - name: Check for VLINT_TOKEN
      id: check
      env:
        VLINT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VLINT_TOKEN }}
      run: |
        if [ -z "$VLINT_TOKEN" ]; then
          echo "::notice title=vlint skipped::No VLINT_TOKEN secret is set."
          echo "available=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        else
          echo "available=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        fi

  vlint:
    needs: check-token
    if: needs.check-token.outputs.available == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Check out repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v6

    - name: Setup vlint
      uses: viash-io/viash-actions/pro/setup-vlint@v6
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.VLINT_TOKEN }}

    - name: `r action$name`
      uses: viash-io/viash-actions/pro/vlint@v6
```
